reference.prompt: Create a NEW character design reference for a compact blue-grey walking reel-to-reel tape recorder enemy, not a bird. Use the attached tiny sprite sheet ONLY for restrained pixel-cluster style and scale; do not copy its animal anatomy. The machine has exactly TWO prominent round cream tape reels in its upper front, a wide horizontal dark speaker grille underneath, a squared carrying handle, a blue-grey metal case and exactly two short mechanical feet. No humanoid head or arms, no screen-face, no text, no lettering, no extra knobs clutter. Left-facing slight three-quarter view, locked camera, light from upper left, hard pixel edges, selective dark outline, no gradients or soft antialiasing. Intended later manual sprite interpretation: 48x48 canvas, 24x24 main collision body, feet fixed at source y44. Palette roles: deep ink #0f191b #2c2330; metal #34354f #575c79 #858eb0; reel faces #cbb696 #f5e8c8; copper #b9905d #e5c386; tiny indicator #9dded1 #d9ffea. Never use #d97757. Exactly FOUR equal-width panels in one horizontal row, same scale and ground line: 1 idle with resting reel spokes, 2 idle with rotated reel spokes, 3 anticipation with the front-left speaker section opening forward slightly and bright tiny indicator, 4 recovery with speaker retracted and dim indicator. No shots, waves or motion lines. Plain neutral grey background, generous margins, no labels, borders, scenery or watermark. Reference only, not a finished game texture.
